Are the images copyright-free for Facebook?
Yes! All assets generated by Lovart on paid plans come with a full commercial license, so you can post them on Facebook, run ads, or use them for your business safely.
Can I edit the text after generating the image?
Absolutely. Lovart's unique 'Text Edit' feature lets you click on any text element within the AI-generated image and change the wording, font, or style instantly.
What if I need a different size for Instagram?
No problem. Just use our 'Smart Resize' tool to instantly adapt your Facebook post (1:1) into an Instagram Story (9:16) or any other format without losing quality.
Can I use my own product photos?
Yes. You can upload your product photo and ask the Agent to place it in a new background or add graphical elements to create a polished promotional post.
Is this better than using Canva templates?
Canva templates are used by millions, so they often look generic. Lovart generates unique, custom designs from scratch based on your specific ideas, giving you a distinctive brand look.
